summary: Onboarding bridge decisions (Issue #15): owner answers to activity-bridge questions are recorded as structured, append-only DECISIONS (not waivers): onboarding_bridge_decisions (bound to the bridge result and item, question, choices offered, choice taken, who/when, reason, evidence at decision time), onboarding_record_bridge_decisions (human only; current bridge result only; open AMBIGUOUS item with a question; choice must be one offered; one decision per item per result) and onboarding_bridge_decisions_view. No accounting table is touched. service_role only.

preflight.name: decision table does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'onboarding_bridge_decisions'

preflight.name: 485 operator function is in place
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_auto_advance'

expected_changes: Creates table onboarding_bridge_decisions (append-only; human-only; unique per bridge result and item) with two indexes and its append-only trigger.
Creates onboarding_record_bridge_decisions and onboarding_bridge_decisions_view (EXECUTE to service_role only).
No row changes in any existing table.

verify.name: decision table present and append-only
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_onboarding_bridge_decisions_append_only'

verify.name: decision functions present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('onboarding_record_bridge_decisions', 'onboarding_bridge_decisions_view')

verify.name: decisions are human-only
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'onboarding_bridge_decisions'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%actor_kind%human%'
